gm-addon.module.general.name: General & Server
gm-addon.module.general.desc: Server detection (germanminer.de), language, second-monitor web bridge & layout.
gm-addon.module.blitzer.name: Speed Camera Alerts
gm-addon.module.blitzer.desc: Warns of speed cameras (HUD, audio alert, 3D markers & Firebase sync).
gm-addon.module.tacho.name: Speedometer & Cruise Control
gm-addon.module.tacho.desc: Speedometer display (analog & digital) with cruise control status and hotkeys.
gm-addon.module.minimap.name: BlueMap Minimap & Map
gm-addon.module.minimap.desc: Centered GermanMiner live minimap and fullscreen map (Key M).
gm-addon.module.spawn_protection.name: Spawn Protection Timer
gm-addon.module.spawn_protection.desc: Displays remaining respawn/login spawn protection as a countdown in the HUD.

gm-addon.setting.language.desc: Choose between auto-detecting Minecraft language (AUTO), English (EN), or German (DE).
gm-addon.setting.force_enable_everywhere: If OFF, the addon is only active on germanminer.de.
gm-addon.setting.reset_all_hud.desc: Resets minimap, speed camera alert, and spawn protection to default positions.
gm-addon.setting.blitzer.enable_hud.desc: Displays the warning widget when approaching a speed camera.
gm-addon.setting.blitzer.only_vehicle.de: Activates speed camera warnings and audio alerts only while in a vehicle.
gm-addon.setting.blitzer.auto_learn.desc: Detects chat flash messages and automatically records camera coordinates.
gm-addon.setting.blitzer.cloud_sync.desc: Allows automatic synchronization of speed cameras with the community cloud.
gm-addon.setting.blitzer.upload_firebase: Automatically uploads newly detected cameras to Firebase (requires active Cloud Sync Opt-In).
gm-addon.setting.blitzer.dedupe_radius.d: Prevents duplicate cameras at the same location (merges cameras within radius).
gm-addon.setting.blitzer.enable_3d_marke: Shows floating camera markers with distance directly in the 3D world.
gm-addon.setting.blitzer.sound_warning.d: Plays an audible warning when approaching a camera or exceeding speed limit.
gm-addon.setting.blitzer.warning_distanc: Distance in blocks/meters to trigger initial speed camera warning.
gm-addon.setting.blitzer.urgent_distance: Distance threshold for urgent red/orange alert stage.
gm-addon.setting.blitzer.cone_deg.desc: Directional cone angle in travel direction (180° = all directions).
gm-addon.setting.blitzer.scale.desc: Size scaling factor for the speed camera HUD widget.
gm-addon.setting.blitzer.sync_now.desc: Reloads local camera database (and syncs with cloud if opted in).
gm-addon.setting.blitzer.show_on_map.des: Displays all known speed cameras on minimap & map.
gm-addon.setting.tacho.enabled.desc: Displays speedometer with current km/h and cruise control status on screen.
gm-addon.setting.tacho.style.desc: Choose between ANALOG (circular dial with needle) and DIGITAL (modern dashboard).
gm-addon.setting.tacho.only_in_vehicle.d: Automatically hides the speedometer when walking on foot.
gm-addon.setting.tacho.speed_calibration: Calibrates vehicle speed for GermanMiner (default: 2.70 = exact 50 km/h).
gm-addon.setting.tacho.max_kmh.desc: Maximum speed displayed on the gauge dial or bar.
gm-addon.setting.tacho.scale.desc: Size scaling factor for speedometer widget in HUD.
gm-addon.setting.minimap.enabled.desc: Displays the BlueMap minimap in the in-game HUD.
gm-addon.setting.minimap.rotate_with_pla: If OFF, North remains fixed at the top (North-Up).
gm-addon.setting.minimap.size.desc: Width and height of the minimap in pixels.
gm-addon.setting.minimap.zoom.desc: Visible diameter on the minimap in blocks.
gm-addon.setting.minimap.scale.desc: Scaling factor of the minimap widget.
gm-addon.setting.minimap.show_markers: Show Server POI Markers (Transit, Gas, Taxis)
gm-addon.setting.minimap.show_markers.de: Displays official GermanMiner BlueMap POIs on the map.
gm-addon.setting.minimap.marker_gas.desc: Show gas stations on minimap & fullscreen map.
gm-addon.setting.minimap.marker_taxis.de: Show taxi stands on minimap & fullscreen map.
gm-addon.setting.minimap.marker_bus.desc: Show bus stops on minimap & fullscreen map.
gm-addon.setting.minimap.marker_train.de: Show train & metro stations on minimap & fullscreen map.
gm-addon.setting.minimap.cache_ttl.desc: Minutes before cached map tiles are re-downloaded from server.
gm-addon.setting.minimap.refresh_now.des: Clears local tile cache and freshly re-fetches all tiles & POIs from map.germanminer.de.
gm-addon.setting.spawn_protection.enable: Displays spawn protection countdown on the HUD.
gm-addon.setting.spawn_protection.durati: Duration of spawn protection timer in seconds (default: 20s).
gm-addon.setting.spawn_protection.on_joi: Automatically starts spawn protection timer when connecting to server.
gm-addon.setting.spawn_protection.on_res: Automatically starts spawn protection timer after respawning from hospital.
Size scaling factor for spawn protection widget.
gm-addon.setting.spawn_protection.test.d: Immediately starts a test countdown of the spawn protection widget.
